시편 97:1.content: The Lord reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

시편 97:2.content: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

시편 97:3.content: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

시편 97:4.content: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

시편 97:5.content: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

시편 97:6.content: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

시편 97:7.content: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

시편 97:8.content: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O Lord.

시편 97:9.content: For thou, Lord, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

시편 97:10.content: Ye that love the Lord, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

시편 97:11.content: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

시편 97:12.content: Rejoice in the Lord, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
